sloka: अभिकालम् ततः प्राप्यते बोधिभवनाच्च्युताम् ।पितृपैतामहीम् पुण्याम् तेरुरिक्षुमतीम् नदीम् ॥२-६८-१७॥
transliteration: abhikālam tataḥ prāpyate bodhibhavanāccyutām ।pitṛpaitāmahīm puṇyām terurikṣumatīm nadīm ॥2-68-17॥

translations.english: From there they reached a village known as Abhikala and crossed the sacred Ikshumati flowing from Bodhibhavana mountain. This region was enjoyed by fathers and forefathers of Dasaratha.
